note: Maps spec rows (spec/target-spec.md, T-01..T-30) to committed records. A row with no entry reads not-yet-measured. Add an entry when its record lands; never edit a spec target to make a row pass. Fields: record (repo path), field (dotted path; [name=X] picks a list item by its name), op (>= <= ==), value or value_field (sibling field of the same record), corner, scope (CH, TC, BOTH or n/a), basis (what the number is), note.

T-05.basis: RTL simulation, every single-fault position (41 cases)
T-05.note: RTL leg only. The SIM leg (mux added load and delay inside T-12/T-13) is not measured.
Repair claim in CH needs an assembly; the mux function is what this record covers.

T-27.basis: RTL simulation, N = 20, DDR latency testbench
T-27.note: The record carries the testbench verdict, not the cycle count.

T-09.basis: simulated, failing T-09 measurements over 720 corner-measurements (DR-0017 driver, head 282a9d4)
T-09.note: Simulated, not measured. Binding corner mos_tt/mixed/-40C, t09_dwell_over_a = 0.0 (no dwell above the level).

T-09.basis: simulated, failing T-09 measurements, L2 wire-bond loopback (reported separately from CH)
T-09.note: Simulated, not measured. TC result only, not a CH claim. The spec expects TC to possibly fail the CH limit; here it did not.

T-19.basis: simulated pre-layout Monte Carlo, worst draw of 900 (20 per corner, mismatch), aperture = setup + hold at the D-pin 50 % crossing, ps
T-19.note: Simulated, not measured. A cell property from ideal 100 ps edges; holds for CH and TC only as far as the declared edge slew does (record claim_scope). Pooled grid.

T-19.basis: simulated pre-layout, klt yield sigma-to-spec (one-sided, target 7 = the 14 sigma peak-to-peak reading)
T-19.note: Normal-model figure; the distribution is not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), the empirical yield 900/900 and the worst draw are the tail used.

T-29.basis: RTL simulation, N = 20: PRBS-7 round trip with the datapath's loopback select on
T-29.note: RTL leg, loopback select function only. This is the digital `l1` path of rtl/aib_datapath.v: it contains no I/O cell, pad or route, so it is NOT the L1 electrical path of test-configuration.md (DR-0019). Port naming filed as #181.

T-29.basis: RTL simulation, N = 20: a decoy on rx_wire corrupts the round trip with the select off and not with it on
T-29.note: RTL leg. Shows the select is real rather than vacuous; still the digital path only (DR-0019).

T-29.corner: PVT-FULL x the route's -20/nominal/+20 % R/C, 135 corners
T-29.basis: simulated, failing T-01 measurements over 270 corner-measurements, L1 on-die loopback through the real cells
T-29.note: Simulated, not measured. SIM leg of L1: bit transfer through the L1 electrical configuration (dout edge count 64.0 at every corner). TC only, never a CH claim. Declared gap: the L1 TopMetal2 route is not in layout/, so the +-20 % R/C band is the declared emulation tolerance of test-configuration.md, not an extracted R/C (owed, #182). The route's inductance is not reproduced (l_mm = 0, DR-0009 Limits).

T-29.corner: PVT-FULL x the route's -20/nominal/+20 % R/C, 135 corners
T-29.basis: simulated, failing T-09 measurements over 2160 corner-measurements, L1 on-die loopback
T-29.note: Simulated, not measured. SIM leg of L1: worst over/undershoot 0.0053 x VOS against the 0.25 bound, zero dwell above the level. T-26 is report-only in L1 (test-configuration.md) and is not cited. Same declared gaps as this record's T-01 entry above; the record's README.md lists them.

T-29.basis: simulated, failing T-09 measurements, L2 wire-bond loopback through the real cells
T-29.note: Simulated, not measured. SIM leg of L2: the existing tb_tc.cir record, now cited for T-29 as well as T-09. Declared gap: the 2 nH/wire and 0.5 pF/pin package values are assumptions until the shuttle packaging is known (test-configuration.md). TC only.
